source.quote: SMSL's own page for the DO300EX, read 2026-11-24: « AK4191+ AK4499EX, taps all the potential of the chip, with distortion as low as a staggering 0.00006% (-124dB) »; « New 3rd generation XMOS XU-316, PCM support up to 32bit/768kHz, DSD support to DSD512 »; « USB, optical fiber, coaxial , AES, I2S support DSD transmission, coaxial and optical fiber support DOP64 ».

facts.chip: « AK4191+ AK4499EX » - modulator plus converter - with a third-generation XMOS XU-316 as the USB interface.

_aes_native_here_too: Like smsl/d400-mk2 and unlike smsl/su-10 and smsl/su-x, AES is in the DSD list and NOT in the DoP list, so it carries native DSD on this model.
